name: Accessory Consistency
description: Analyzes accessory rendering consistency in 비디오
algorithm: Accessory Consistency — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes 비디오 frames for deepfake and AI generation detection:

1. **Frame Extraction**: Key frames are extracted from the 비디오 stream for analysis.

2. **Feature Analysis**: Analyzes accessory rendering consistency in 비디오. Relevant visual and temporal features are computed per frame.

3. **Temporal Consistency Check**: Features are tracked across consecutive frames to detect inconsistencies.

4. **Pattern Matching**: Results are compared against known deepfake artifact patterns.

5. **점수 계산**: A confidence score (0-100) reflecting the likelihood of AI manipulation is calculated.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through accessory consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
